agreements: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational progress only; category alone never makes them verified Experience.
HEARTBEAT, POLL, RETRY, WAIT, reconnect, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
The current anti-thrash branch does not delay a safety/recovery downshift because it only holds selected_n > current_n.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in the present executable; keep it observational and non-authoritative.
formal_mutation_allowed=false and v2.1 has no authority to mutate P_base, Identity, Personality or Governance.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly labels speed improvement NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.
Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved if v2/v2.1 is rejected.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are caller-supplied rather than evidence-bound; stale secretary state can be presented as fresh and non-bool truthy values are not rejected.
disagreements.required_change: Use a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope plus trusted authority comparison and strict runtime typing; unbound/stale inputs fail closed.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision, so permissive caller v2 inputs can still route above an authority-required recovery state.
disagreements.required_change: Consume an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope/snapshot and project its safe decision; missing/stale/revoked/cross-scope authority evidence fails closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, observation window, sample count or uncertainty; 1/1 or 2/3 observations can trigger a hold.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty semantics and bounded release behavior.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can suppress safe upshift indefinitely and lower apparent gear-shift rate while worsening cycle completion, verified closure throughput or recovery latency.
disagreements.required_change: Bound hold/cooldown/release and require paired non-regression on cycle, closure and recovery metrics.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still depends on event kind plus bool(independently_verified), not an exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier receipt; bool('false') evaluates True.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable event/evidence identity, trusted verifier receipt, mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and durable acceptance record; non-bool verification flags fail closed.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe is transient per aggregate call. Same evidence under new IDs, same ID across restarts/polls/rollback, or the same ID rebound to different evidence can be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a rollback-resistant accepted-event/evidence-lineage registry: exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate, same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Route both verified Experience and operational progress through one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt authority path; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: current_gear is caller-supplied while directly controlling v2 hysteresis and v2.1 anti-thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive current_gear from canonical monotonic runtime/shift state bound to installation/runtime identity and policy hash.

disagreements.finding: verification_stage is caller-supplied; self-reporting C_VERIFIED can remove the unverified G4 cap without exact C evidence or acceptance-state binding.
disagreements.required_change: Derive verification_stage from trusted verifier/acceptance receipts bound to exact mission, step, scope, evidence, freshness and revocation state.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or a promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline, precommit, uncertainty or non-inferiority protocol exists for the declared speed metrics.
disagreements.required_change: Use matched workload paired baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency; commits and awake time are forbidden evidence.

disagreements.finding: durable_progress_per_wake can improve solely by changing wake/coalescing cadence or eligible-wake definition.
disagreements.required_change: Freeze canonical eligible-wake and scheduler policies; bind numerator/denominator to durable records and require corroborating wall-clock metrics.

disagreements.finding: verified_closure_per_hour can be gamed by different observation horizons or censoring blocked/recovery/verifier-wait/failure time differently between baseline and candidate.
disagreements.required_change: Precommit identical exposure clock, start/stop, downtime censoring, interrupted-run and workload-arrival policies.

disagreements.finding: Fixed baseline-then-candidate order is confounded by cache warming, recovered faults, prior durable state, verifier availability and runtime/operator learning.
disagreements.required_change: Use randomized AB/BA or equivalent crossover from the same sealed starting snapshot; reset candidate-sensitive runtime state while preserving external monotonic audit/evidence state.

disagreements.finding: Even with matched workload, frozen clocks and randomized arm order, a candidate can improve completed-task closure/hour and latency by deferring, timing out, rejecting or never closing the hardest assigned work. Metrics computed only on completed work create survivorship/selection bias and can label reduced coverage as speedup.
disagreements.required_change: Evaluate speed on an intention-to-treat assigned-workload basis. Precommit admission/defer/timeout policy, count every assigned unit, report completion/coverage/defer/timeout rates, and treat unclosed work with common right-censoring or bounded failure semantics. A speedup claim is invalid if apparent gains require lower workload coverage or selective deferral.

statistical_risks: Caller-forged secretary freshness, authority conflict, current gear or verification stage changes routing exposure and invalidates causal speed comparisons.
Small-n shift-rate estimates have extreme variance and can create false anti-thrash holds.
Anti-thrash can improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle latency, verified closure throughput or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later wired from progress created by the same routing policy back into upshift decisions.
Transient event identity and dual credit paths permit longitudinal verified/operational credit inflation.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
durable_progress_per_wake is denominator-sensitive to candidate-dependent wake cadence.
verified_closure_per_hour is sensitive to observation-window and censoring policy.
Paired runs remain biased if treatment order is fixed and runtime state carries over between arms.
Completed-only speed metrics have survivorship bias when the candidate can selectively defer/reject/timeout hard work.
Unmatched incident mix, verifier availability, cache/warm-state, routing history and completion coverage confound claimed speedup.
proposed_tests: GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001: stale RED/ORANGE cannot affect gear via caller-forged freshness; non-bool freshness/conflict values reject fail-closed.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted authority=G1/recovery plus permissive caller fallback still produces G1; stale/revoked/cross-scope authority receipts reject.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017: canonical shift-ledger derivation wins over caller recent_shift_rate_ratio.
GB21-SHIFT-SMALL-N-004: 1/1 and 2/3 cannot trigger production anti-thrash absent preregistered support/uncertainty semantics.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RECOVERY-005: safe upshift resumes under bounded policy with non-regressed closure/cycle/recovery metrics.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008: same canonical evidence under 10,000 IDs credits once.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 / ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 / POLL-REPLAY-020: exactly-once acceptance survives calls, restart, rollback and repeated polling.
GB21-EVENT-REBIND-021: same event_id with changed kind/evidence/verifier receipt is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; exact original replay is no-op.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero verified credit; non-bool verification flags reject.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 / OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: 10,000 receipt-less decision calls create zero additional verified or operational credit.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-013: DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND never change verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance or formal authority.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate 5/4/3 scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.
GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-FORGE-034: canonical runtime gear wins over forged caller current_gear.
GB21-VERIFICATION-STAGE-FORGE-035: caller C_VERIFIED without exact trusted C receipt retains unverified cap.
GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015: matched baseline reports all five core speed/quality metrics with uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression; commits/awake time excluded.
GB21-WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 / RATIO-GAMING-031: freeze eligible-wake policy and reject ratio-only gains caused by fewer counted wakes.
GB21-TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 / CENSORING-GAMING-033: identical exposure clocks/censoring remove artificial closure-per-hour gains.
GB21-ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 / CARRYOVER-RESET-037: candidate effect survives AB/BA order reversal from sealed matched snapshots with candidate-sensitive state reset.

GB21-ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: every assigned workload item remains in the analysis denominator; report completion, defer, reject, timeout and verified-closure rates plus assignment-to-closure latency.
GB21-HARD-TASK-DEFERRAL-GAMING-039: force candidate to defer the hardest stratum; completed-only metrics may improve but ITT/coverage-aware analysis must reject the speedup claim.
release_condition: Do not modify formal authority and do not claim C PASS from this review.
Fresh secretary/authority decisions, current gear and verification stage must be evidence-bound, replay-resistant and strictly typed.
Anti-thrash metrics must derive from canonical shift history with preregistered sample/window/uncertainty and bounded release behavior.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance; operational progress remains separate.
All verified and operational credit must flow through one durable replay-resistant acceptance registry/receipt path.
DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only; heartbeat/poll/retry/reconnect/window age/runtime uptime remain zero Experience; P_base stays read-only.
5/4/3/1 weights remain TEST_REQUIRED heuristics and cannot establish capability truth or promotion.

Any speedup claim requires matched assigned workload, intention-to-treat coverage accounting, frozen wake/exposure/censoring rules, randomized AB/BA or equivalent crossover, all five core speed metrics, uncertainty, verification/risk non-regression, and no gain produced by selective defer/reject/timeout behavior.
Commit count, wake count and awake/window time are forbidden as standalone speedup evidence.
v1 verified baseline and Step009 verified foundation remain preserved regardless of v2.1 verdict.
small_world_return_rule: After latest-only review write+readback, return to fresh SMALL_WORLD_TRIPARTITE_ACTIVE; write no QUANTUM turn unless next_expected_source=QUANTUM.
